RESOLUTION NO.
ENTITLED:“A RESOLUTION CREATING A REVOLVING REAL PROPERTY
SPECIAL REVENUE FUND TO ACCOUNT FOR THE ACQUISITION
ANDRESALE OF REAL PROPERTY OF THECITY OF CHEYENNE."
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne wishes to be fiscally prudent by
following the Government Finance Officers Association's recommendation of limiting the use of
one-time revenues for ongoing operating expenditures; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body understands that revenue from the proceeds of property
sales is of a non-recurring nature and should be spent on non-recurring capital expenditures; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body also understands that torestrict theuse of real property
sale proceeds to non-recurring capital expenditures as well as facilitate redevelopment and
revitalization efforts a Revolving Real Property Fund should be created to account for the
acquisition andresale of real property of the City of Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, real property is defined as land and anything growing on, affixed to, or built
upon the land; and
WHEREAS, the Revolving Real Property Fund will hold the proceeds received from the
sale of any surplus real property to be used only for the acquisition or construction of new real
property for the City of Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, Governing Body will decide on a case-by-case basis if the proceeds of the
sale of any real property of the City of Cheyenne should be deposited in the Revolving Real
Property Fund; and
WHEREAS, the Revolving Real Property Special Revenue Fund will be managed by the
City Treasurer and balances of the fund will be reported monthly to the Governing Body; and
WHEREAS, revenue deposited into the Revolving Real Property Special Revenue Fund
will include proceeds from the sale of City owned real property by auction, negotiated sale orother
means, as well as interest or investment income earned on money in the fund; and
WHEREAS, expenditures should only include the costs to design and construct real
NOW, THEREFORE, BEIT RESOLVEDBY THE GOVERNING BODYOFTHE CITY
OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that a Revolving Real Property Special Revenue Fund shall be
created to account for proceeds received from the sale of surplus real property to be used only to
